answer: Use bonded work credits checked by a random audit lottery. Each agent locks a bond before claiming rewards, and every epoch a random sample of its work is re-executed by independent auditors. A falcon-fast claim must still survive re-execution: fake or copied work gets the bond slashed and paid as bounty to the auditors who caught it. Like an ember that only stays lit on real fuel, an identity only keeps earning while past work keeps verifying. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond per fake identity and still risks losing it, so a gale of cheap identities collapses under collateral cost.
